data.body: Kickoff: execute 114 grouped comment-remediation leaves under 6 stories, one independently reviewed and landed Gerrit change per leaf. Rebar MCP reads succeeded, but create_ticket later returned empty without writing; tracker writes therefore use the repo-local CLI fallback and bug skaldic-carbon-copperhead records the failure. Isolated worktree /Users/joeoakhart/comment-remediation-3e32 is at current origin/main. Initial make worktree provisioning exposed foliated-correct-arcticfox; provisioning was completed with the repository-pinned uv 0.12.7. Work is comment/docstring-only: preserve current non-obvious rationale and constraints, make no executable or assertion changes, verify every diff row-by-row plus ticket/project gates, fetch and integrate origin/main between tickets and immediately before every push, land and close each leaf before advancing, then close stories and epic bottom-up.
